## Equations
### EQ001 — Spin coherent state and Husimi-Q distribution

*observable for all six QPD panels*

$$
\langle S,m|\theta,\phi\rangle=\binom{2S}{S+m}^{1/2}\cos^{S+m}(\theta/2)\sin^{S-m}(\theta/2)e^{-im\phi},\quad Q(\theta,\phi)=|\langle\theta,\phi|\psi\rangle|^2
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `paper QPD definition note [12]`, `Appendix coherent-state expansion` · source: paper_pdf: raw/paper.pdf pp. 5139, 5142 (Fig. 2 caption and Appendix)

Numerical form:

```
log-binomial coherent-state amplitudes and vectorized overlap on a spherical grid
```

Code: `src/spin_squeezing/model.py::coherent_state`, `src/spin_squeezing/model.py::husimi_q`


### EQ002 — One-axis twisting state evolution

*state generator for Fig. 2*

$$
U_{OAT}(\mu)=e^{-i\mu S_z^2/2},\quad |\psi(\mu)\rangle=U_{OAT}(\mu)|\pi/2,0\rangle
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `H=hbar chi Sz^2`, `mu=2 chi t` · source: paper_pdf: raw/paper.pdf p. 5139, Sec. III.A and Fig. 2 caption

Numerical form:

```
exact diagonal phase in the Sz eigenbasis
```

Code: `src/spin_squeezing/model.py::one_axis_state`


### EQ003 — Exact and asymptotic one-axis variances

*one-axis series and asymptote in Fig. 4*

$$
V_-=\frac S2\left[1+\frac{S-1/2}{2}\left(A-\sqrt{A^2+B^2}\right)\right],\ A=1-\cos^{2S-2}\mu,\ B=4\sin(\mu/2)\cos^{2S-2}(\mu/2)
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `paper twisted moments`, `2x2 transverse covariance eigenvalues` · source: paper_pdf: raw/paper.pdf p. 5140, Eqs. (3)-(5)

Numerical form:

```
bounded scalar minimization of the exact closed form for each S
```

Code: `src/spin_squeezing/model.py::one_axis_variances`, `src/spin_squeezing/model.py::minimum_one_axis_variance`


### EQ004 — Two-axis countertwisting evolution

*state generator for Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 TACT series*

$$
U_{TACT}(\mu)=\exp[-i\mu(S_xS_y+S_yS_x)/4]
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `S_{pi/2,pi/4}^2-S_{pi/2,-pi/4}^2=SxSy+SySx`, `mu=4 chi t` · source: paper_pdf: raw/paper.pdf p. 5140, Eq. (6) and Fig. 3 caption

Numerical form:

```
Hermitian eigendecomposition followed by exact spectral phases
```

Code: `src/spin_squeezing/model.py::two_axis_state`


### EQ005 — Minimum transverse covariance eigenvalue

*coordinate-independent squeezing observable*

$$
V_{min}=\tfrac12[C_{xx}+C_{yy}-\sqrt{(C_{xx}-C_{yy})^2+4C_{xy}^2}]
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `symmetric spin covariance`, `Rayleigh-Ritz theorem` · source: paper_pdf: raw/paper.pdf pp. 5139-5140, Eqs. (3)-(4) and squeezing definition

Numerical form:

```
smallest eigenvalue of the exact 2x2 transverse covariance matrix
```

Code: `src/spin_squeezing/model.py::minimum_transverse_variance`
